prompts.ko: Create a production-ready transparent PNG title wordmark for a cozy Korean 2D gravity puzzle game. Exact text only: '데굴데굴' (four Hangul syllables, 데 굴 데 굴, perfectly legible, one horizontal line). Wide approximately 3:1 canvas, tightly composed with 5% breathing room, entire lettering uncropped. Very chunky rounded hand-lettered Korean typography with soft slightly irregular edges and gently bouncing baseline. Matte, fluffy, hand-painted gouache / colored-pencil texture with fine paper-grain inside letters, pale cream and lilac lavender fills, restrained peach accents, muted deep-purple thin outline and a very shallow lavender offset shadow for modest volume. Fits a pastel cream/lavender casual game featuring square soft characters. Soft 2D illustrated finish, NOT shiny plastic, NOT glossy 3D, NO metallic highlights, NO chrome, NO glass, NO heavy bevels, NO photorealism. Only a couple of tiny flat yellow four-point sparkles beside lettering, no characters or background scenery. Transparent alpha background, no checkerboard drawn, no backdrop, no slogan, no English, no extra text, no watermark. The words must read exactly 데굴데굴.
